set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
option(VITADECK_WERROR "Treat compiler warnings as errors (CI only; newer compilers add warnings)" OFF)
add_executable(glyph_cache_harness tests/glyph_cache_harness.c src/ui/glyph_cache.c src/core/util.c)
target_compile_definitions(glyph_cache_harness PRIVATE VD_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
if(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND)
target_compile_definitions(glyph_cache_harness PRIVATE VD_TWEMOJI_DOWNLOADED)
endif()
target_link_libraries(glyph_cache_harness m)
add_test(NAME glyph_cache_harness COMMAND glyph_cache_harness)

# Colour emoji images: Twemoji's 72px PNGs, downloaded once at configure time into the gitignored assets/emoji.
# A failed download only warns; the build then ships no images and emoji draw a fallback glyph.
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION 17.0.3)
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256 d8a269885d95c78123cc0981c8c76a4c55466cdcb6c7c939434323533e6cd754)
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL "https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/archive/refs/tags/v${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}.zip")
function(vitadeck_fetch_twemoji)
set(dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/emoji")
set(stamp "${dir}/.twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND OFF PARENT_SCOPE)
if(EXISTS "${stamp}")
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
return()
endif()
if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.18)
message(WARNING "Twemoji needs CMake 3.18 to extract; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
return()
endif()
set(staging "${dir}/.download")
set(archive "${staging}/twemoji.zip")
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
message(STATUS "Downloading Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
file(DOWNLOAD "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}" "${archive}" STATUS status INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT 60 TLS_VERIFY ON)
list(GET status 0 code)
set(problem "")
if(NOT code EQUAL 0)
list(GET status 1 problem)
else()
file(SHA256 "${archive}" hash)
if(NOT hash STREQUAL VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256)
set(problem "SHA-256 is ${hash}, expected ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256}")
endif()
endif()
if(problem)
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
message(WARNING "Twemoji download from ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL} failed: ${problem}. "
"The build has no emoji images, so emoji draw a fallback glyph. Reconfigure to retry.")
return()
endif()
set(images_dir "twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}/assets/72x72")
file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${staging}" PATTERNS "${images_dir}/*.png")
file(GLOB previous "${dir}/*.png" "${dir}/.twemoji-*")
if(previous)
file(REMOVE ${previous})
endif()
file(GLOB images "${staging}/${images_dir}/*.png")
foreach(image IN LISTS images)
get_filename_component(name "${image}" NAME)
# The emoji loader names images with U+FE0F left out.
string(REPLACE "-fe0f" "" name "${name}")
file(RENAME "${image}" "${dir}/${name}")
endforeach()
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
list(LENGTH images count)
if(count EQUAL 0)
message(WARNING "Twemoji archive has no ${images_dir}/*.png; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
return()
endif()
file(WRITE "${stamp}" "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}\n")
message(STATUS "Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}: ${count} images in assets/emoji")
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
vitadeck_fetch_twemoji()

# Twemoji

The 72×72 PNG emoji that `cmake/twemoji.cmake` downloads into this folder are [Twemoji](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji) v17.0.3, copyright Twitter, Inc and other contributors, and Jason Sofonia & Justine De Caires and other contributors, licensed under [CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) (full text in `LICENSE.txt`).
Changed from the original: files are renamed to drop `-fe0f` (U+FE0F) from their names. The images are unmodified.
- name: Install host native dependencies
run: brew install raylib pkgconf cmake ccache
- name: Cache Twemoji
uses: actions/cache@v5
with:
path: assets/emoji
key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
- name: Configure and build host target
run: |
CCACHE="$(brew --prefix ccache)/bin/ccache"
cache-from: type=gha,scope=smoke
cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=smoke
- name: Cache Twemoji
uses: actions/cache@v5
with:
path: assets/emoji
key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
- name: Smoke test
# macOS cannot initialize NSGL for raylib on GitHub runners — see docs/adr/0002-smoke-ci-linux-xvfb.md
run: VITADECK_SMOKE_NO_BUILD=1 scripts/smoke-docker.sh test
cache-from: type=gha,scope=vitadeck-vitasdk-v3
cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=vitadeck-vitasdk-v3
- name: Cache Twemoji
uses: actions/cache@v5
with:
path: assets/emoji
key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
- name: Build Vita target in Vitasdk container
env:
VITADECK_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
esac
if [[ -n "${LOCAL_UID:-}" && -n "${LOCAL_GID:-}" ]]; then
chown -R "$LOCAL_UID:$LOCAL_GID" "$BUILD_DIR" js/dist js/examples/smoke/dist tests/fixtures/smoke_golden.Linux.png 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R "$LOCAL_UID:$LOCAL_GID" "$BUILD_DIR" js/dist js/examples/smoke/dist assets/emoji tests/fixtures/smoke_golden.Linux.png 2>/dev/null || true
fi

+++ b/cmake/twemoji.cmake
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+# Colour emoji images: Twemoji's 72px PNGs, downloaded once at configure time into the gitignored assets/emoji.
+# A failed download only warns; the build then ships no images and emoji draw a fallback glyph.
+set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION 17.0.3)
+set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256 d8a269885d95c78123cc0981c8c76a4c55466cdcb6c7c939434323533e6cd754)
+set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL "https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/archive/refs/tags/v${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}.zip")
+
+function(vitadeck_fetch_twemoji)
+  set(dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/emoji")
+  set(stamp "${dir}/.twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
+  set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND OFF PARENT_SCOPE)
+  if(EXISTS "${stamp}")
+    set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
+    return()
+  endif()
+  if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.18)
+    message(WARNING "Twemoji needs CMake 3.18 to extract; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
+    return()
+  endif()
+
+  set(staging "${dir}/.download")
+  set(archive "${staging}/twemoji.zip")
+  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
+  message(STATUS "Downloading Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
+  file(DOWNLOAD "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}" "${archive}" STATUS status INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT 60 TLS_VERIFY ON)
+  list(GET status 0 code)
+  set(problem "")
+  if(NOT code EQUAL 0)
+    list(GET status 1 problem)
+  else()
+    file(SHA256 "${archive}" hash)
+    if(NOT hash STREQUAL VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256)
+      set(problem "SHA-256 is ${hash}, expected ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256}")
+    endif()
+  endif()
+  if(problem)
+    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
+    message(WARNING "Twemoji download from ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL} failed: ${problem}. "
+                    "The build has no emoji images, so emoji draw a fallback glyph. Reconfigure to retry.")
+    return()
+  endif()
+
+  set(images_dir "twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}/assets/72x72")
+  file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${staging}" PATTERNS "${images_dir}/*.png")
+  file(GLOB previous "${dir}/*.png" "${dir}/.twemoji-*")
+  if(previous)
+    file(REMOVE ${previous})
+  endif()
+  file(GLOB images "${staging}/${images_dir}/*.png")
+  foreach(image IN LISTS images)
+    get_filename_component(name "${image}" NAME)
+    # The emoji loader names images with U+FE0F left out.
+    string(REPLACE "-fe0f" "" name "${name}")
+    file(RENAME "${image}" "${dir}/${name}")
+  endforeach()
+  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
+  list(LENGTH images count)
+  if(count EQUAL 0)
+    message(WARNING "Twemoji archive has no ${images_dir}/*.png; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
+    return()
+  endif()
+  file(WRITE "${stamp}" "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}\n")
+  message(STATUS "Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}: ${count} images in assets/emoji")
+  set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
+endfunction()
+
+vitadeck_fetch_twemoji()

lines.text: # Colour emoji images: Twemoji's 72px PNGs, downloaded once at configure time into the gitignored assets/emoji.
# A failed download only warns; the build then ships no images and emoji draw a fallback glyph.
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION 17.0.3)
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256 d8a269885d95c78123cc0981c8c76a4c55466cdcb6c7c939434323533e6cd754)
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL "https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/archive/refs/tags/v${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}.zip")
function(vitadeck_fetch_twemoji)
set(dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/emoji")
set(stamp "${dir}/.twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND OFF PARENT_SCOPE)
if(EXISTS "${stamp}")
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
return()
endif()
if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.18)
message(WARNING "Twemoji needs CMake 3.18 to extract; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
return()
endif()
set(staging "${dir}/.download")
set(archive "${staging}/twemoji.zip")
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
message(STATUS "Downloading Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
file(DOWNLOAD "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}" "${archive}" STATUS status INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT 60 TLS_VERIFY ON)
list(GET status 0 code)
set(problem "")
if(NOT code EQUAL 0)
list(GET status 1 problem)
else()
file(SHA256 "${archive}" hash)
if(NOT hash STREQUAL VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256)
set(problem "SHA-256 is ${hash}, expected ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256}")
endif()
endif()
if(problem)
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
message(WARNING "Twemoji download from ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL} failed: ${problem}. "
"The build has no emoji images, so emoji draw a fallback glyph. Reconfigure to retry.")
return()
endif()
set(images_dir "twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}/assets/72x72")
file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${staging}" PATTERNS "${images_dir}/*.png")
file(GLOB previous "${dir}/*.png" "${dir}/.twemoji-*")
if(previous)
file(REMOVE ${previous})
endif()
file(GLOB images "${staging}/${images_dir}/*.png")
foreach(image IN LISTS images)
get_filename_component(name "${image}" NAME)
# The emoji loader names images with U+FE0F left out.
string(REPLACE "-fe0f" "" name "${name}")
file(RENAME "${image}" "${dir}/${name}")
endforeach()
file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
list(LENGTH images count)
if(count EQUAL 0)
message(WARNING "Twemoji archive has no ${images_dir}/*.png; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
return()
endif()
file(WRITE "${stamp}" "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}\n")
message(STATUS "Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}: ${count} images in assets/emoji")
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
vitadeck_fetch_twemoji()

@@ -75,6 +75,12 @@ jobs:
       - name: Install host native dependencies
         run: brew install raylib pkgconf cmake ccache
 
+      - name: Cache Twemoji
+        uses: actions/cache@v5
+        with:
+          path: assets/emoji
+          key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
+
       - name: Configure and build host target
         run: |
           CCACHE="$(brew --prefix ccache)/bin/ccache"
@@ -120,6 +126,12 @@ jobs:
           cache-from: type=gha,scope=smoke
           cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=smoke
 
+      - name: Cache Twemoji
+        uses: actions/cache@v5
+        with:
+          path: assets/emoji
+          key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
+
       - name: Smoke test
         # macOS cannot initialize NSGL for raylib on GitHub runners — see docs/adr/0002-smoke-ci-linux-xvfb.md
         run: VITADECK_SMOKE_NO_BUILD=1 scripts/smoke-docker.sh test

lines.text: - name: Install host native dependencies
run: brew install raylib pkgconf cmake ccache
- name: Cache Twemoji
uses: actions/cache@v5
with:
path: assets/emoji
key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
- name: Configure and build host target
run: |
CCACHE="$(brew --prefix ccache)/bin/ccache"
cache-from: type=gha,scope=smoke
cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=smoke
- name: Cache Twemoji
uses: actions/cache@v5
with:
path: assets/emoji
key: twemoji-${{ hashFiles('cmake/twemoji.cmake') }}
- name: Smoke test
# macOS cannot initialize NSGL for raylib on GitHub runners — see docs/adr/0002-smoke-ci-linux-xvfb.md
run: VITADECK_SMOKE_NO_BUILD=1 scripts/smoke-docker.sh test

lines.text: esac
if [[ -n "${LOCAL_UID:-}" && -n "${LOCAL_GID:-}" ]]; then
